purpose: Collect local, CI, and sandbox proof outputs into one debuggable evidence bundle so strict proof failures are actionable instead of scattered across terminal logs.

gate_artifacts.label: Python reference and parity suite
gate_artifacts.remediation: Run python -m compileall -q netcoin tools, python tools/run_parity_suite.py --no-write, and the full pytest suite until all failures are resolved.

gate_artifacts.label: Rust workspace compilation and tests
gate_artifacts.remediation: Install Rust/Cargo, run cd core-rs && cargo test --workspace, then capture the output as reports/rust_workspace_report.json.

gate_artifacts.label: Executed Rust parity binaries
gate_artifacts.remediation: Run python tools/run_all_rust_parity.py --strict after cargo test --workspace succeeds. Source-only reports are acceptable only in sandbox mode.

gate_artifacts.label: TypeScript API, OpenAPI contract, and parity
gate_artifacts.remediation: Run cd api && npm ci && npm run ci:api, then python tools/run_ts_api_contract_enforcement.py --run-npm --out reports/ts_api_contract_report.json.

gate_artifacts.label: Real browser E2E matrix
gate_artifacts.remediation: Install Playwright browsers and run python tools/run_browser_e2e_matrix.py --run-playwright --out reports/browser_e2e_matrix_report.json.

gate_artifacts.label: Accessibility matrix
gate_artifacts.remediation: Run the strict accessibility matrix with browser tooling and resolve keyboard, screen-reader, contrast, focus, and touch-target failures.

gate_artifacts.label: Security and release evidence
gate_artifacts.remediation: Run python tools/run_security_audit_prep.py and python tools/run_release_readiness.py --strict, then resolve any blocker statuses. Use python tools/run_local_proof.py --profile strict to capture per-gate logs before collecting evidence.

gate_artifacts.label: Phase 0 product and anti-sprawl guardrails
gate_artifacts.remediation: Run python tools/check_phase0_complete.py plus all Phase 0 validators and fix any product architecture drift before adding new surfaces.

blocker_classes.meaning: A required report or source artifact was not produced.
A report proves source structure but not real external execution.
A proof command or report explicitly failed.
The artifact exists but does not match the current release version or expected gate.

phase1_2_exit_criteria: Every proof gate has remediation text
The evidence bundle lists hashes and sizes for every discovered artifact
Strict blockers are grouped by gate and class
make v0392-check passes in sandbox/source mode
tools/run_local_proof.py can execute sandbox profile, capture per-gate logs, and write reports/local_proof_run_report.json
